title: AI_TRIAGE Output Schema
description: Every AI_TRIAGE output must match this structure exactly, or it gets quarantined by JSON_VALIDATION.

variant_id.description: Unique identifier for the variant, e.g. chr1_12345_A_T

rules_triggered.description: List of which rules fired for this variant, e.g. ['high_impact_coding', 'rare_allele']

rule_version.description: Version of the rule set used, e.g. v1.0.0 — lets us trace which logic produced this result

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this triage decision was made
